observations: Photo 0: Blue underbone motorcycle with front headlamp, front fork, and front wheel visible; front fender and indicators present; some dirt/wear on body panels.
Photo 0: Side of tank shows text that appears to include “X T 100” (not fully clear).
Photo 1: Rear/side view shows seat, rear suspension springs, rear wheel, and a rear rack/guard; license plate is visible but not readable in full.
Photo 1: “X100” text appears on the side panel (partially readable).
Photo 2: Rear view shows tail light, rear rack/guard, and a license plate with Nigeria styling; plate text is not fully readable.
Photo 2: Exhaust/muffler and rear indicators visible; overall condition looks used with road dust and minor scuffs.

identity.model: X100 (text appears on side panel in photo 0 and photo 1)

claims.evidence: No photo evidence of ownership history or giveaway origin.

claims.claim: okay buy and drive to any location with battery everything
claims.evidence: Photos show the motorcycle but do not show it starting/running, battery condition, or road test.
Battery presence/health and electrical functionality cannot be confirmed from still photos.

risks.risk: Engine may not start or may have running issues (carb/ignition/compression) despite cosmetic condition
risks.proof: Short video clip of a cold start + idle for 1–2 minutes, then a slow ride and stop.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed to start/drive (worst case: needs inspection/repairs).

risks.risk: Battery may be weak/dead or charging system may be faulty
risks.proof: Photo of battery label + voltage reading (multimeter) and a video showing headlight/indicators working while engine runs.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as battery/electrical not confirmed (worst case: may need battery replacement).

risks.risk: Brake and tire condition may be poor (safety risk) even if wheels look present
risks.proof: Close-up photos of brake pads/shoes (front & rear), tire tread depth, and a video of hard braking on a flat road.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as brakes/tires may need service (worst case: replacement/adjustment).

risks.risk: Missing/incorrect parts or electrical wiring issues (indicators, horn, tail light, speedometer)
risks.proof: Video showing all lights and horn: headlight high/low, both indicators, brake light, tail light, horn, and speedometer working.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as electrical not fully confirmed (worst case: some lights may not work).

risks.risk: Frame/engine damage or accident repair not visible in these angles
risks.proof: Photos of both sides of the frame near engine mounts + steering head alignment check + VIN/engine number area (clear).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown history (worst case: possible hidden damage requiring inspection).

proof_requests: Send a short video: cold start, then engine running smoothly for 1–2 minutes.
Show all electricals working (headlight, indicators, horn, brake light, tail light) in one clip.
Show battery: photo of battery and a multimeter voltage reading (engine off and engine running).
Close-up photos of tires tread + front and rear brake condition.
Clear photos of engine number/VIN and the full license plate.
response.reason: The photos show a used X100-type motorcycle in decent cosmetic condition, but the seller’s key claims (“okay… buy and drive… battery everything”) are not verifiable remotely without start/run and electrical/brake proof. Missing decisive proof prevents a confident worst-case price.
